issue.title: Blocks (*) picker disables non-^prj project residents the writer accepts (a project cannot depend on its own resident)

task_type_fields.impact: Valid * picker rows are disabled with a false reason in bob capture-complete, shell completion, and Bob Mac Capture's Blocks picker; the user must hand-type the *note:id token. No vault corruption.
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by the bob-cli-7r land agent while verifying that epic's new parent-picker guard (which copied this rule).

Scratch vault: `project.md` (frontmatter `type: [[project]]`, `status: wip`) holds `- [ ] #task Project root ^prj` and `- [ ] #task Other resident ^other`; `resident.md` (frontmatter `parent: [[project]]`) holds `- [ ] #task Resident ^resident`.

```
bob capture-complete -b VAULT -c 20 -f json -- '@resident+resident *'
  project.md prj   | a project cannot depend on its own resident   (correct: the writer refuses)
  project.md other | a project cannot depend on its own resident   (WRONG)
bob capture -b VAULT --dry-run -- '@resident+resident *project:other'
  [dry-run] ok would update  resident.md ... 🧱 would now block "Other resident" ...   (rc=0)
```

Root cause: in `blocked_task_candidates` (`src/native/capture_complete/candidates.rs`, `let internal_project = recognized_project_paths.contains(&task.note_path) && (...)`, introduced in 78f1a69 by bob-cli-7n) the guard checks only whether the candidate lives in a recognized project note that contains (or is an ancestor of) the owner. The writer only refuses when the dependent is the project's own `^prj` line (`prj_context_for_dependent` + `refuse_internal_prj_targets` in `src/native/capture/dependencies.rs` / `project_deps.rs`). Fix: also require the candidate's block id to be that project's open `^prj` task. Epic bob-cli-7r's land tale fixes the same over-disabling in its new `+`/`@route+` parent-picker guard (`project_resident_relation`), so reuse that corrected helper here if it has landed.

issue.creation_reason: The Blocks (`*`) picker greys out valid blocked-task rows that the writer accepts, so Bryan cannot pick an ordinary project resident to block from inside that project's sub-tree. Pre-existing since bob-cli-7n; surfaced while landing bob-cli-7r.

payload.description: Epic bob-cli-7r's land tale fixes the identical over-disabling in the new +/@route+ parent-picker guard (project_resident_relation); reuse that helper
